identity.name: Luminor Submersible 42mm 3 Days Automatic

case.bezel: unidirectional rotating dive bezel with 60-minute scale

identity.one_liner: Panerai's 42mm steel Submersible dive watch, produced 2019-2021 and succeeded by PAM01973.

narrative.story: Introduced as part of Panerai's 2019 Submersible relaunch, PAM00973 brought a 42mm case with a unidirectional dive bezel to the line, built around the automatic P.900 movement. Panerai discontinued it in 2021 in favor of the closely related PAM01973.
narrative.collector_notes: The 42mm case is the smallest in the modern Submersible range; confirm bezel-insert condition and rubber-strap configuration, since near-identical cases were offered under multiple adjacent reference numbers.
